result.instructions: Tools for Rebuy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products does Rebuy recommend next to product 123456 in our store?"; "Show our top sellers and trending products this week."; "What does the custom ruleset 'cart-upsell' recommend for a cart of 2 items worth 80.00?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rebuy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rebuy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rebuy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rebuy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rebuy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rebuy_recommended_products
tools.title: Recommended products
tools.description: Return the highest-converting cross-sell products for a product, collection or cart context. Rebuy API: GET /api/v1/products/recommended.

shopify_product_ids.description: Comma-separated Shopify product ids (the source product or products).

shopify_collection_id.description: Shopify collection id to base the recommendations on.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

filter_oos.description: Leave out products that are out of stock.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code for currency and availability.
